clips.title: The story
paras: At Solliden Farmstead, living humans still tend pumpkins in blighted Tirisfal. The Forsaken take them for the Royal Apothecary Society’s mixtures.

West of Brill, crops still grow despite the corruption spreading across Lordaeron. At Solliden Farmstead, living human farmers work the soil and grow large orange pumpkins under the watch of the nearby Scarlet Crusade. The harvest feeds these farmers. To the Forsaken of Brill, the pumpkins are targets for sabotage and raw materials for Apothecary Johaan.

Deathguard Simmer sends young Forsaken into the contested fields to steal pumpkins from under the farmers’ noses. The vegetables do not feed the dead; they go into the Royal Apothecary Society’s cauldrons. Apothecaries test how natural plants react to plagues and experimental mixtures, using Lordaeron’s remaining crops against the living.
